name: First Kiss☆Story
source:
With only a month left until high school graduation, the protagonist, Mizusawa Yoshihiko, has to move to the city of Akizuki due to his father's sudden job transfer. He ends up staying at the home of his father's acquaintance, which is a household of women: a widow and her two daughters. While the younger sister, Manami, takes a liking to him, the older sister, Kana, completely dislikes him, leading to a complicated start to his new living situation. 
In addition to this, he meets and interacts with various women, including a younger schoolmate and a girl who is hospitalized. Who will be the one to share the protagonist's first kiss?

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ファーストKiss☆物語]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
距离高中毕业只剩一个月时，主人公水泽芳彦因父亲突然调职，不得不搬到秋月市。他借住在父亲熟人家中，那里只有一名寡妇和两个女儿。妹妹真奈美很快对他产生好感，姐姐香奈却十分讨厌他，令全新的同居生活有了复杂的开端。
除此之外，他还会遇见并接触多名女性，包括低年级学妹和住院少女。最终与主人公分享初吻的人会是谁？

[翻译自[url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ファーストKiss☆物語]Wikipedia[/url]]
